paragraphs.text: Jenzo is a human mechanic from Kamigawa .

Jenzo is a young mechanic from Far Corner who has recently been studying at the Imperial Academy. He is a skilled engineer, demonstrated by his adept handling of various devices and his work on disruptors. After losing a hand in a violent encounter with the Mukotai Reckoners gang, Jenzo received a prosthetic replacement, which he quickly adapted to using. He is characterized by his resilience and determination to help his community despite his injuries.

Jenzo became a target of the Mukotai Reckoners gang after a member of their group was mysteriously killed in Far Corner. In retaliation, the Mukotai maimed Jenzo, nailing his severed hand to the town's gate and leaving him severely injured. Upon returning to Far Corner, Jenzo warned the community of the imminent danger, prompting them to prepare for an attack. During the ensuing conflict, Jenzo bravely attempted to arm a disruptor device but was attacked by a Mukotai mech. He was saved by Ayari and continued to assist in the town's defense. Despite the chaos, Jenzo's quick thinking and mechanical skills played a crucial role in the town's efforts to fend off the Mukotai, though the battle ended tragically with the emergence of the vengeful kami, Kaima , forcing Jenzo and Ayari to flee their home or be killed.
